acceptanceCriteriaVerified: Given seeded epidemiological protocols in the database, When a client queries protocol search or CRUD endpoints, Then the system returns matching protocol entities with search and filter capabilities.
Given the new search API and UI, When the automated test suite executes, Then unit, integration, and E2E tests validate the complete search workflow.
Given the tests are running, When they complete, Then all tests pass and verify accurate search results and visible feedback.
notes: Verified backend REST API search endpoints and frontend ProtocolSearch component with comprehensive unit, integration, and E2E test suites (44 Java backend tests, 20 frontend Vitest tests).
